description: This is a Java test class for the GlobalLocaleList class, containing unit tests that verify the behavior of global property change handling and allowed locales management within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: GlobalLocaleListTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class testing the behaviors of GlobalLocaleList regarding global property changes and locale settings.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of GlobalLocaleList before each test.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged_shouldSetAllowedLocalesIfGlobalPropertyIsAnEmptyString
methods.description: Tests that allowed locales are set to Locale.ROOT when the global property is an empty string.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged_shouldSetAllowedLocalesIfGlobalPropertyContainsTwoLocales
methods.description: Tests that allowed locales are correctly set to Locale.CANADA and Locale.FRENCH when the global property contains 'en_CA,fr'.
